The rear run returns from the second case-body D-ring up the BACK to the SAME LEFT shoulder. In BACK view, the band slopes from viewer UPPER LEFT down to viewer LOWER RIGHT. Two load-bearing case-body D-rings, one continuous shoulder loop. No second crossing strap; no unsupported floating case; no misleading loose diagonal straps.
Required accessory placement when held: magnifying glass in HER RIGHT HAND (front viewer LEFT), two dark teal/navy reference books plus small yellow tabbed notebook supported by HER LEFT ARM (front viewer RIGHT). ONE dark teal rigid toolbox with lavender handle and lavender closure, on HER RIGHT HIP. Open toolbox reveals neatly seated screwdriver, wrench, ruler, lavender safety scissors and yellow tape.
